start.speaker: senna
start.text: Stop there. I've got a pistol and a hole in my side, and I'm not sure which one gives out first. Concord?

choices.text: Easy. I'm not here to kill you. Passenger, trying to reach the launch bay.
(In Haldis dialect) Light goes home, sister. Put it down.

effects.reason: Spoke to Senna in her own tongue

choices.text: Who are you, and why are you bleeding in a refrigerator?

drop.speaker: senna
drop.text: Or what? You'll shoot me? Get in line behind your ship. ...Fine. It's down. I couldn't lift it again anyway.

dialect.speaker: senna
dialect.text: ...Where did a Concord passenger learn to say that? The pistol's down. Don't make me regret it.

who.speaker: senna
who.text: Senna Thorne. Lantern Office, scout section. The cutters caught me in the aisle. My squad thinks I'm dead, probably. We came for the hold.

choices.text: What's in the hold, from your side?
Your people boarded a refugee ship with breaching charges.

lantern.speaker: senna
lantern.text: Our dead. The Concord kept prisoners at Vesper and Callan. The Lattice copied them before they died, or instead of letting them live. Three thousand people. On Haldis we carry the dead to a lantern hall and speak their names into flame so their light goes home. The Assembly wants them home. That's all. You keep calling it evidence. We call it Grandmother.

lantern_tav.speaker: tav7
lantern_tav.text: Then we agree on what they are, Senna Thorne. We may not agree on what to do with them.

charges.speaker: senna
charges.text: We cut into a ship that was running away with our families in its hold. Your WARDEN started killing passengers before we finished the first breach. Pick who you hate. I'm too tired to argue.

treat_offer.speaker: senna
treat_offer.text: You'd do that? For a reclaimer?

choices.text: Hold still. I'm going to treat that.

success_effects.reason: Showed mercy to a wounded combatant

failure_effects.reason: Tried to treat a wounded enemy scout
Showed mercy to a wounded combatant

effects.reason: Gave a medpac to a wounded enemy scout
Showed mercy to a wounded combatant

choices.text: Tell me your squad's passphrase, or I leave you here for the cutters.
Help me reach the bay safely, and I'll see your people get what they came for.

effects.reason: Promised the dead would go home

choices.text: Go. Find your people. Tell them who let you walk.
You boarded a refugee ship. This ends here.

kill_confirm.speaker: narrator
kill_confirm.text: Senna sees it in your face before you move. She doesn't beg. She closes her eyes and starts saying names under her breath.

treat_ok.speaker: senna
treat_ok.text: Hah — that stings. ...Thank you. Listen. My squad is in the central aisle: Abeni, Rusk, and Dov. If they see you, say 'ember-tide' and say Senna sent you. They'll listen. And if you reach Bay 2, tell Marshal Quill I'm alive and who to thank.

treat_bad.speaker: senna
treat_bad.text: Gods — you've torn the packing. ...No, leave it, it'll hold long enough. The passphrase is 'ember-tide'. Tell Marshal Quill I'm alive. Tell him you tried.

intim_ok.speaker: senna
intim_ok.text: 'Ember-tide.' That's the word. I hope it chokes you. My squad will listen to it. The Marshal won't forget who taught you it.

intim_fail.speaker: senna
intim_fail.text: You'll leave me for the cutters? Then leave. You won't get a word.

bargain.speaker: senna
bargain.text: You'll see they come home? ...Then the word is 'ember-tide', and I'll tell the Marshal you gave your oath. Don't break it. We remember oaths longer than names.

release.speaker: senna
release.text: Just... let me go? I'll tell Marshal Quill an operator let me walk. Whatever you are, I'll tell him that.

killed.speaker: narrator
killed.text: It is quick. The names stop.

kill_iona.speaker: iona
kill_iona.text: She was wounded and she'd put the pistol down. That's not a fight, {name}. That's an execution, and I watched it.

kill_tav.speaker: tav7
kill_tav.text: A pattern ended. I am recording the names she was saying. Someone should finish them.

after_wait.speaker: senna
after_wait.text: Go on. The aisle's that way. Ember-tide, if you need it.

after_gone.speaker: narrator
after_gone.text: Only a smear of blood marks where Senna was hiding.
